 Team news - Brobbey back for Sunderland, Calvert-Lewin starts for Leeds published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Sunderland v Leeds (16:30 BST) 
 Brian Brobbey returns for his first Sunderland appearance since being injured on international duty with the Netherlands in September. In his most recent outing for the Black Cats, he scored a hat-trick against Manchester City.
 Sunderland XI: Roefs, Brobbey, Angulo, Rigg, O'Nien, Reinildo, Mukiele, Sadiki, Le Fee, Hume, Xhaka.
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin is fit to start up front for Leeds, who make three changes from last weekend's draw against Manchester United.
 Leeds XI: Trafford, Justin, Bijol, Muharemovic, Bogle, Ampadu, Tanaka, Gudmundsson, Aaronson, Wilson, Calvert-Lewin.

 Man Utd 0-2 Bournemouth 
 Bournemouth should be four or five up to be honest.
 Rayan picks up the ball and Lisandro Martinez is claiming he's fouled as he falls over but it is simply that. He falls over.
 The shot is off target but it should be 3-0. At least.

Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 These changes make no sense from Michael Carrick - absolutely no sense. 
 I don't know how you're not bringing on Zirkzee? You need a goal, you need attacking players on the pitch.

 GOAL - Hull 1-1 Brentford published at 15:20 GMT 15:20 GMT 
 Dango Ouattara (63 mins) 
 Image source, Getty Images This is all a bit of a mess from Hull and Brentford have the equaliser.
 The ball comes in and Hull don't deal with it. In fact it's kneed straight to Igor Thiago, who dinks it back across goal for Dango Ouattara to tap home.
 Well dealt with by Brentford but it was fairly easy.
